posts.title: King tide swamps waterfront, but spares Berkeley from damage
posts.description: A rainstorm that officials feared could supercharge sea levels instead passed through Berkeley well before high tide.

posts.title: Oakland and Berkeley dog attacks: What you need to know about a disturbing series of violent encounters
posts.description: The man recently arrested on suspicion of animal cruelty has yet to be charged. The two cane corsos have not been located, and victims say they’re struggling to get a response from police.

posts.title: Plan for hundreds of apartments at Ashby BART may have cleared its final vote
posts.description: The City Council approved design standards for housing at the station’s primary parking lot. The project will be eligible for fast-tracked approval.
